data.body: Hypothesis result 2026-09-09: confirmed. Before the patch, targeted local reproduction with coverage failed via pytest-timeout during setup of test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs while importing pydantic_ai; after changing only that test's local timeout marker from 3s to 30s and adding a regression guard in test_timeout_budget_headroom.py, the same targeted coverage run passes alongside the original MCP peer-finished-clone test. This fixes the currently observed worker-crash class without weakening the actual lifespan assertion, which still requires the TestClient path itself to complete in <2s.
